info.name: Biblios API — Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Source-controlled executable test collection for the Biblios backend API.

Setup:
1. Import the matching local Postman environment.
2. The default API URL is http://localhost:8081/api/v1 and the health URL is http://localhost:8081/health.
3. Run Register User or Login before authenticated requests; successful authentication stores the token automatically.
4. Moderator and admin requests require an explicitly provisioned non-production account.

The router, OpenAPI contract, and this collection are checked for drift in CI. Never store real credentials or tokens in this file.
